name: org.machanism.machai:bindex-maven-plugin
description: Bindex Maven Plugin integrates Machai workflows with Apache Maven to generate and register structured Bindex metadata for semantic artifact discovery and GenAI-assisted integration. It provides four thread-safe Maven goals. The aggregator goals bindex and register execute once for an entire reactor and can run without a Maven project; bindex-per-module and register-per-module execute separately in each Maven module and require a project. Generation delegates to the bindex Machai Act, while registration delegates to bindex/register. Shared Ghostwriter configuration supports a workflow configuration file, AI model selection, supplemental instructions, excluded paths, Maven settings credentials selected by server ID, and arbitrary action-specific parameters. The plugin supports OpenAI, Anthropic, CodeMie, local tool-only YAML, and disabled provider modes through the underlying Machai GenAI client, making it suitable for automated documentation analysis, metadata generation, registry publication, and multi-module build pipelines.

usageContext: Generate Bindex metadata from Maven project documentation
Generate one metadata document for a Maven reactor
Generate metadata independently for every reactor module
Register generated metadata with a configured Bindex registry
Use Maven settings server credentials for AI-assisted workflows
Run OpenAI, Anthropic, CodeMie, local tool-only, or disabled provider modes

constructors.description: Creates the reactor-wide Maven mojo for the bindex goal. Maven normally instantiates this class reflectively and injects the active session, project when available, settings, base directory, and workflow parameters.

examples.description: Shows the fully qualified Java type. In production, users invoke the Maven goal rather than constructing the mojo directly because Maven performs parameter injection.

constructors.description: Creates the project-required, per-module Maven mojo for the bindex-per-module goal. Maven creates one execution in the context of each applicable reactor module.

examples.description: Shows the fully qualified implementation type; normal use is through the bindex-per-module Maven goal.

constructors.description: Creates the reactor-wide Maven mojo that delegates metadata registration to the bindex/register Machai workflow.

examples.description: Identifies the fully qualified registration implementation. Maven users normally invoke the register goal.

constructors.description: Creates the project-required Maven mojo that registers Bindex metadata independently for the current reactor module.

examples.description: Identifies the fully qualified per-module registration implementation; Maven supplies its execution context.

features.name: bindex
features.description: Generates Bindex metadata once for the current Maven reactor by delegating to the bindex Machai Act. This goal is an aggregator, is thread-safe, can execute without a Maven project, and resolves compile and runtime dependencies.

examples.description: Runs reactor-wide generation after credentials and workflow options have been configured. Maven instantiates org.machanism.machai.bindex.maven.BindexMojo.

features.name: bindex-per-module
features.description: Generates Bindex metadata separately for every applicable Maven module. This thread-safe non-aggregating goal requires a Maven project and passes the current module, reactor session, settings, and configured parameters to the bindex Act.

examples.description: Runs module-scoped generation from a project or multi-module reactor. Maven invokes org.machanism.machai.bindex.maven.BindexPerModuleMojo for each applicable module.

features.name: register
features.description: Registers generated Bindex metadata once for a reactor by delegating to the bindex/register Machai workflow. The goal is a thread-safe aggregator and can run without a Maven project.

examples.description: Registers the generated reactor metadata using the registry and credential configuration inherited by org.machanism.machai.bindex.maven.RegisterMojo.

features.name: register-per-module
features.description: Registers the Bindex metadata associated with each Maven module by delegating to the bindex/register workflow with the current project and reactor context.

examples.description: Runs registration in each applicable module through org.machanism.machai.bindex.maven.RegisterPerModuleMojo.

customizations.name: Ghostwriter workflow parameters
customizations.description: Configure gw.config, gw.model, gw.instructions, gw.excludes, and genai.serverId as Maven properties. Additional action-specific name/value pairs can be supplied in the plugin params map and are forwarded unchanged to the selected Machai Act.

examples.description: Configures model selection, Maven server credentials, and an action-specific output parameter in the plugin declaration.

examples.title: Install, configure, and generate reactor-wide Bindex metadata
examples.installation: Add <plugin><groupId>org.machanism.machai</groupId><artifactId>bindex-maven-plugin</artifactId><version>1.4.1</version></plugin> inside the build plugins section of pom.xml, or invoke the fully qualified goal directly without editing the POM.
examples.configuration: If the selected AI provider requires credentials, add <server><id>machai-genai</id><username>your-api-user</username><password>your-api-key</password></server> to the servers section of the user Maven settings.xml. Keep secrets outside pom.xml. Select the model with gw.model and the server with genai.serverId; optional properties include gw.config, gw.instructions, and gw.excludes.
examples.run: From the reactor root, run mvn org.machanism.machai:bindex-maven-plugin:1.4.1:bindex -Dgw.model=gpt-4o-mini -Dgenai.serverId=machai-genai.
examples.result: The plugin invokes the bindex Machai Act once with reactor context and generates structured Bindex metadata for review and downstream semantic discovery.

examples.title: Bind generation to every module in a multi-module build
examples.installation: Declare org.machanism.machai:bindex-maven-plugin:1.4.1 in the parent POM build plugins section.
examples.configuration: Add an execution containing <goals><goal>bindex-per-module</goal></goals>. Configure model, instructions, exclusions, credentials, and params either in the plugin configuration or with Maven properties.
examples.run: Run mvn verify from the reactor root when the execution is bound to a lifecycle phase, or invoke mvn org.machanism.machai:bindex-maven-plugin:1.4.1:bindex-per-module directly.
examples.result: Maven executes org.machanism.machai.bindex.maven.BindexPerModuleMojo in each applicable module so every module can produce metadata in its own project context.

examples.title: Register generated metadata
examples.installation: Use the same org.machanism.machai:bindex-maven-plugin:1.4.1 plugin installation used for generation.
examples.configuration: Provide registry connection details and credentials through the selected Ghostwriter workflow configuration and Maven settings server. Use the reactor goal for one metadata document or the per-module goal when every module owns its metadata.
examples.run: Run mvn org.machanism.machai:bindex-maven-plugin:1.4.1:register for reactor-wide registration, or mvn org.machanism.machai:bindex-maven-plugin:1.4.1:register-per-module for module-scoped registration.
examples.result: The plugin delegates publication to the bindex/register Machai workflow with the appropriate reactor or module context.
